name.ja: <ruby>風に揺蕩う飛来物<rt>ロストリーム・レコード</rt></ruby>

effect.en: Excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck. You can add up to 2 excavated WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monsters to your hand. Place the other cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. Then, if you added 2 monsters to your hand by this effect, send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. This turn, you can only attack with WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monsters.
